# Times of India

> > India's leading English daily newspaper covering national news, Bollywood entertainment, regional updates, and celebrity interviews.

Times of India delivers comprehensive coverage spanning Indian cinema (particularly Bollywood stars like Allu Arjun, Alia Bhatt, and Rashmika Mandanna), state-level politics and news from regions like Bihar and Goa, and exclusive celebrity interviews. The publication serves as a primary source for both entertainment and serious journalism across India.

## Key Topics

- Bollywood News
- Hindi Cinema
- Allu Arjun
- Pushpa 2
- Rashmika Mandanna
- Alia Bhatt
- State Politics
- Bihar News
- Nitish Kumar
- Goa News
- Regional News
- Celebrity Interviews
- Municipal Elections
- Government Recruitment
- Actor Interviews

## Regional & State News

- [Bihar News: Latest Bihar News Headlines, Bihar Samachar - Times of Indiandia](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/bihar): Bihar state news hub covering politics, crime, BPSC updates & Nitish Kumar
- [Goa News: Latest News, Headlines & Updates on Crime, Politics, and More | Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/goa): Goa city news covering local politics, crime, municipal elections & updates

## Bollywood & Entertainment

- [On screen romance can be a put-off: Ruchita  | Hindi Movie News - Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/On-screen-romance-can-be-a-put-off-Ruchita/articleshow/35149103.cms): Interview with Kannada actress Ruchita Prasad on on-screen romance
